key_insight: Trustworthy AI-assisted formalization in scientific computing requires identifying layer-specific failures and supplying expert feedback to recover mathematical soundness.
engineering_relevance: The study offers practical guidance for using AI proof agents across scientific computing software layers without treating proof completion alone as evidence of correctness.
method: Study AI-assisted formalization through case studies across scientific computing abstraction layers.
Classify failure modes and the expert feedback needed to recover soundness.
Derive a workflow for recurring proof patterns.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a cross-layer case-study evaluation of numerical proof completion and failures, but provides no quantitative success rates.
watch_item: Computational procedures and modeling transformations may require expert interpretation beyond the support available in existing formal libraries.
paper_title: AI-Assisted Auto-formalization for Trustworthy Scientific Computing: Case Studies and Lessons Learned
